name: Shapes
description: A collection of all the Shape objects on the specified slide.
remarks: Each Shape object represents an object in the drawing layer, such as an AutoShape, freeform, OLE object, or picture.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: HasTitle
properties.description: Returns whether the collection of objects on the specified slide contains a title placeholder. Read-only.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the slide title. Read-only.

properties.name: Placeholders
properties.description: Returns a Placeholders collection that represents the collection of all the placeholders on a slide. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.signature: Item(Index As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a single Shape object from the specified Shapes collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the single Shape object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: AddCallout
methods.signature: AddCallout(Type As MsoCalloutType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a borderless line callout. Returns a Shape object that represents the new callout.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of callout line.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the callout's bounding box relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the callout's bounding box relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the callout's bounding box, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the callout's bounding box, measured in points.

methods.name: AddConnector
methods.signature: AddConnector(Type As MsoConnectorType, BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a connector. Returns a Shape object that represents the new connector. When a connector is added, it is not connected to anything. Use the BeginConnect and EndConnect methods to attach the beginning and end of a connector to other shapes in the document.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of connector.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the connector's starting point relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the connector's starting point relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the connector's ending point relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the connector's ending point relative to the top edge of the slide.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.signature: AddCurve(SafeArrayOfPoints As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a Bzier curve. Returns a Shape object that represents the new curve.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the vertices and control points of the curve. The first point you specify is the starting vertex, and the next two points are control points for the first Bzier segment. Then, for each additional segment of the curve, you specify a vertex and two control points. The last point you specify is the ending vertex for the curve. Note that you must always specify 3n + 1 points, where n is the number of segments in the curve.

methods.name: AddLabel
methods.signature: AddLabel(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a label. Returns a Shape object that represents the new label.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The text orientation. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the label relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the label relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the label, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the label, measured in points.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.signature: AddLine(BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a line. Returns a Shape object that represents the new line.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the line's starting point relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the line's starting point relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the line's ending point relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the line's ending point relative to the top edge of the slide.

methods.name: AddPicture
methods.signature: AddPicture(FileName As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file from which the OLE object is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked picture will be saved with the document into which it is inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if LinkToFile is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the picture relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the picture relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, measured in points.

methods.name: AddPolyline
methods.signature: AddPolyline(SafeArrayOfPoints As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an open polyline or a closed polygon drawing. Returns a Shape object that represents the new polyline or polygon.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the polyline drawing's vertices.

methods.name: AddShape
methods.signature: AddShape(Type As MsoAutoShapeType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an AutoShape. Returns a Shape object that represents the new AutoShape.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of AutoShape to create.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the AutoShape relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the AutoShape relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the AutoShape, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the AutoShape, measured in points.

methods.name: AddTextEffect
methods.signature: AddTextEffect(PresetTextEffect As MsoPresetTextEffect, Text As String, FontName As String, FontSize As Single, FontBold As MsoTriState, FontItalic As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a WordArt object. Returns a Shape object that represents the new WordArt object.

parameters.name: PresetTextEffect
parameters.description: The preset text effect.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description: The name of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontSize
parameters.description: The size (in points) of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontBold
parameters.description: Determines whether the font used in the WordArt is set to bold.

parameters.name: FontItalic
parameters.description: Determines whether the font used in the WordArt is set to italic.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the WordArt's bounding box relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the WordArt's bounding box relative to the top edge of the slide.

methods.name: AddTextbox
methods.signature: AddTextbox(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a text box. Returns a Shape object that represents the new text box.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The text orientation. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the text box relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the text box relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the text box, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the text box, measured in points.

methods.name: BuildFreeform
methods.signature: BuildFreeform(EditingType As MsoEditingType, X1 As Single, Y1 As Single) As FreeformBuilder
methods.description: Builds a freeform object. Returns a FreeformBuilder object that represents the freeform as it is being built.

parameters.name: EditingType
parameters.description: The editing property of the first node.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the top edge of the slide.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.signature: SelectAll()
methods.description: Selects all the shapes in a Shapes collection.

methods.name: Range
methods.signature: Range([Index As Variant]) As ShapeRange
methods.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents a subset of the shapes in a Shapes collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual shapes that are to be included in the range. Can be an Integer that specifies the index number of the shape, a String that specifies the name of the shape, or an array that contains either integers or strings. If this argument is omitted, the Range method returns all the objects in the specified collection.

methods.name: AddTitle
methods.signature: AddTitle() As Shape
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted title placeholder to a slide. Returns a Shape object that represents the restored title.

methods.name: AddOLEObject
methods.signature: AddOLEObject([Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single], [ClassName As String], [FileName As String], [DisplayAsIcon As MsoTriState], [IconFileName As String], [IconIndex As Long], [IconLabel As String], [Link As MsoTriState]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an OLE object. Returns a Shape object that represents the new OLE object.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the upper-left corner of the slide. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the upper-left corner of the slide. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial width of the OLE object, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial height of the OLE object, in points.

parameters.name: ClassName
parameters.description: The OLE long class name or the ProgID for the object that's to be created. You must specify either the ClassName or FileName argument for the object, but not both.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file from which the object is to be created. If the path isn't specified, the current working folder is used. You must specify either the ClassName or FileName argument for the object, but not both.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: Determines whether the OLE object will be displayed as an icon.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: The file that contains the icon to be displayed.

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: The index of the icon within IconFileName. The first icon in the file has the index number 0 (zero). If an icon with the given index number doesn't exist in IconFileName, the icon with the index number 1 (the second icon in the file) is used. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: A label (caption) to be displayed beneath the icon.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: Determines whether the OLE object will be linked to the file from which it was created. If you specified a value for ClassName, this argument must be msoFalse.

methods.name: AddPlaceholder
methods.signature: AddPlaceholder(Type As PpPlaceholderType, [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted placeholder on a slide. Returns a Shape object that represents the restored placeholder.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of placeholder. Placeholders of type ppPlaceholderVerticalBody or ppPlaceholderVerticalTitle are found only on slides of layout type ppLayoutVerticalText, ppLayoutClipArtAndVerticalText, ppLayoutVerticalTitleAndText, or ppLayoutVerticalTitleAndTextOverChart. You cannot create slides with any of these layouts from the user interface; you must create them programmatically by using the Add method or by setting the Layout property of an existing slide.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the placeholder relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the placeholder relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the placeholder, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the placeholder, in points.

methods.name: Paste
methods.signature: Paste() As ShapeRange
methods.description: Pastes the shapes, slides, or text on the Clipboard into the specified Shapes collection, at the top of the z-order. Each pasted object becomes a member of the specified Shapes collection. If the Clipboard contains entire slides, the slides will be pasted as shapes that contain the images of the slides. If the Clipboard contains a text range, the text will be pasted into a newly created TextFrame shape. Returns a ShapeRange object that represents the pasted objects.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.signature: AddTable(NumRows As Long, NumColumns As Long, [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a table shape to a slide.

parameters.name: NumRows
parameters.description: The number of rows in the table.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns in the table.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance (in points) from the left edge of the slide to the left edge of the table.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance (in points) from the top edge of the slide to the top edge of the table.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width (in points) of the new table.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height (in points) of the new table.

methods.name: PasteSpecial
methods.signature: PasteSpecial([DataType As PpPasteDataType], [DisplayAsIcon As MsoTriState], [IconFileName As String], [IconIndex As Long], [IconLabel As String], [Link As MsoTriState]) As ShapeRange
methods.description: Pastes the contents of the Clipboard, using a special format.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description: A format for the Clipboard contents when they're inserted into the document. The default value varies, depending on the contents in the Clipboard. An error occurs if the specified data type in the DataType argument is not supported by the clipboard contents.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: MsoTrue to display the embedded object (or link) as an icon.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoTrue, this argument is the path and file name for the file in which the icon to be displayed is stored. If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoFalse, this argument is ignored.

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoTrue, this argument is a number that corresponds to the icon you want to use in the program file specified by IconFilename. For example, 0 (zero) corresponds to the first icon, and 1 corresponds to the second icon. If this argument is omitted, the first (default) icon is used. If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoFalse, then this argument is ignored. If IconIndex is outside the valid range, then the default icon (index 0) is used.

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoTrue, this argument is the text that appears below the icon. If this label is missing, Microsoft PowerPoint generates an icon label based on the Clipboard contents. If DisplayAsIcon is set to msoFalse, then this argument is ignored.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: Determines whether to create a link to the source file of the Clipboard contents. An error occurs if the Clipboard contents don't support a link.

methods.name: AddMediaObject2
methods.signature: AddMediaObject2(FileName As String, [LinkToFile As MsoTriState], [SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState], [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Replaces deprecated Shapes.AddMediaObject method (PowerPoint). Adds a new media object.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to be added.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Indicates whether to link to the file.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Indicates whether to save the media with the document.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the left edge of the slide to the left edge of the media object.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the top edge of the slide to the top edge of the media object.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the media object. Default value is -1.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the media object. Default value is -1.

methods.name: AddMediaObjectFromEmbedTag
methods.signature: AddMediaObjectFromEmbedTag(EmbedTag As String, [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a media object from an embedded tag to a Shapes object.

parameters.name: EmbedTag
parameters.description: The embed tag.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the left edge of the slide to the left edge of the media object.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the top edge of the slide to the top edge of the media object.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the media object.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the media object.

methods.name: AddSmartArt
methods.signature: AddSmartArt(Layout As SmartArtLayout, [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a SmartArt diagram to the Shapes object.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: The SmartArt diagram to add.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the left edge of the slide to the left edge of the SmartArt diagram.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the top edge of the slide to the top edge of the SmartArt diagram.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the SmartArt diagram.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the SmartArt diagram.

methods.name: AddChart2
methods.signature: AddChart2([Style As Long], [Type As XlChartType], [Left As Single], [Top As Single], [Width As Single], [Height As Single], [NewLayout As Boolean]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a chart to the document. Returns a Shape object that represents a chart and adds it to the specified collection.

methods.name: AddPicture2
methods.signature: AddPicture2(FileName As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, [Width As Single], [Height As Single], [compress As MsoPictureCompress]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file from which the OLE object is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked picture will be saved with the document into which it is inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if _LinkToFile_ is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the picture relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the picture relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: compress
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture should be compressed when inserted.

methods.name: AddInkShapeFromXML
methods.signature: AddInkShapeFromXML(InkXML As String, Left As Single, Top As Single, [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an ink shape. Returns a Shape object that represents the new ink shape.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the ink shape relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the ink shape relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the ink shape, measured in points. If this parameter is not specified, the width is calculated based off of the InkActionML.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the ink shape, measured in points. If this parameter is not specified, the hight is calculated based off of the InkActionML.

methods.name: Add3DModel
methods.signature: Add3DModel(FileName As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, [Width As Single], [Height As Single]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a Model3DFormat object from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new 3D model.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file from which the 3D model object is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the 3D model will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked 3D model will be saved with the document into which it is inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if LinkToFile is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the 3D model relative to the left edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the 3D model relative to the top edge of the slide.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the 3D model, measured in points (enter -1 to auto-calculate a width based on the 3D model dimensions).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the 3D model, measured in points (enter -1 to auto-calculate a height based on the 3D model dimensions).
